leverage.en: A crowbar uses leverage to pry nails out of wood.
leverage.zh: 撬棍利用杠杆原理，把钉子从木头里撬出来。

procrastinate.en: He procrastinated until the last minute and had to stay up all night to finish.
procrastinate.zh: 他一直拖到最后一刻，不得不熬夜把事情做完。

negotiate.en: The client and server computers must first negotiate a network protocol to be used.
negotiate.zh: 客户端与服务器计算机必须先协商好要使用的网络协议。

chore.en: Washing dishes is a chore, but we cannot just stop eating.
chore.zh: 洗碗是件烦人的杂活，但我们总不能从此不吃饭吧。

incentive.en: Management offered the sales team a $500 incentive for each car sold.
incentive.zh: 管理层向销售团队承诺：每卖出一辆车，就有 500 美元的奖励。

reservation.en: I have a hotel reservation in the name of Mr Smith.
reservation.zh: 我用史密斯先生的名字预订了酒店房间。

warranty.en: I made sure to check the terms of my warranty for my computer to ensure I was covered in case it broke down.
warranty.zh: 我特意查看了电脑的保修条款，确保万一出故障也能获得保障。

compromise.en: He tried to compromise the security in the computer by guessing the password.
compromise.zh: 他试图通过猜测密码来攻破这台电脑的安全防护。

subscription.en: I have a monthly subscription to the Daily Telegraph newspaper.
subscription.zh: 我订了《每日电讯报》的月度订阅。

consensus.en: After years of debate over the best wine to serve at Thanksgiving, no real consensus has emerged.
consensus.zh: 围绕感恩节该上哪种葡萄酒争论了多年，至今仍未形成真正的共识。

refund.en: If the camera is faulty, you can return it to the store where you bought it for a full refund.
refund.zh: 如果相机有质量问题，可以退回购买的商店，获得全额退款。

recipe.en: His new approach is definitely a recipe for success.
recipe.zh: 他的新方法绝对是成功的秘诀。

feasible.en: His plan to rid Trafalgar Square of pigeons by bringing in peregrine falcons to eat them was dismissed as not feasible.
feasible.zh: 他提出用引入游隼捕食的办法清理特拉法加广场的鸽子，该计划因不具可行性被否决。

reluctant.en: She was reluctant to lend him the money
reluctant.zh: 她不太愿意把钱借给他。

utility.en: I've bought a new disk utility that can recover deleted files.
utility.zh: 我买了一个新的磁盘工具软件，可以恢复被删除的文件。

resign.en: He resigned the crown to follow his heart.
resign.zh: 他为追随内心而让出了王位。

fulfill.en: You made a promise, son, and now you must fulfill it.
fulfill.zh: 你许下了诺言，孩子，现在就必须兑现它。

coordinate.en: Give me your coordinates and we'll come and rescue you.
coordinate.zh: 把你的坐标发给我，我们就来救你。

thorough.en: He is the most thorough worker I have ever seen.
thorough.zh: 他是我见过的做事最细致周全的员工。
